live_matches.description: Team India makes history as the first-ever women's Test match at the iconic Lord's Cricket Ground begins today against hosts, England. Captains Nat Sciver-Brunt and Harmanpreet Kaur lead their sides, marking a massive milestone 142 years after men first played a Test at the venue. Tune in to catch all the action from Day 1 of this one-off test from India Women's Tour of England 2026, LIVE & exclusively on Sony LIV.
